hero.title: Less noise, more vision.
hero.subtitle: I'm Miclos. In a world saturated with content, I direct, shoot and produce the work that actually connects.

manifesto.label: 01 / MANIFESTO
parrafos: In a market producing more noise than ever, my job is to make the good work look good.
Nice-looking content with no decision behind it sells nothing, says nothing, is remembered by no one.
Every piece is the proof that there was a real intention behind it.

services.label: 02 / SERVICES
services.intent: I don't make content to fill a grid. I make images and video built from strategy, so your brand looks as solid as your product actually is. I bring strategic judgment and technical execution together to close the gap between what gets planned and what gets published.

items.title: Commercial & editorial photography
items.focus: Food, product, fashion, lifestyle and test model.
items.purpose: Photography built to raise perceived value and justify the price of your product or service.

items.title: Reels & commercial video
items.focus: Ad spots, B2B commercials, dynamic reels, sound design and 4K colour grading.
items.purpose: Video production optimised for engagement and conversion on social and paid media.

items.title: Creative direction & campaigns
items.focus: Brand Core Sprint, verbal identity, full visual system and campaign direction end to end.
items.purpose: Full-service partnership for brands after an international standard and total visual coherence.
